articles.title: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack

events.summary: Cryptocurrency platform Binance has covered 90% of losses following a $6.3 billion hack. The FBI attributed the massive cyberattack to North Korea.
events.why: State-sponsored cyber hefts of this scale directly fund sanctioned regimes while demonstrating severe vulnerabilities in global financial infrastructure.

articles.title: US to suspend South Africa and Rwanda from duty-free trade access

events.summary: The United States is suspending duty-free trade access for South Africa and Rwanda. The loss of preferential access will impact $1.7 billion worth of annual South African exports, notably including vehicles and agricultural goods.
events.why: The withdrawal of major preferential trade status causes immediate economic friction and reshapes export markets and bilateral diplomatic ties.

articles.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say

events.summary: Israeli strikes across Gaza have killed eight individuals, including a child and five Hamas-run police officers, according to hospital officials. The deaths occurred in Khan Younis and Gaza City.
events.why: Targeted strikes in an active conflict zone result in irreversible loss of life and impact local administrative stability.

articles.title: US midterms campaign 'shattering' spending records to be most expensive ever

events.summary: Campaign spending for the 2026 US midterm elections is projected to reach nearly $12 billion, setting a new historical record. BBC Verify is investigating the primary sources of the unprecedented political funding.
events.why: Unprecedented campaign expenditure reflects shifting electoral dynamics and expanding influence of private capital in national governance.

articles.title: 'I couldn't be silent': Iranian teen's mother seeking justice after daughter shot dead

events.summary: An Iranian mother is publicly confronting the regime following the killing of her teenage daughter Sevda by security forces. The case has been documented by BBC Panorama.
events.why: Public defiance by families of victims underscores persistent domestic opposition to state repression in Iran.

articles.title: Iran killed her teenage daughter - now she is facing up to the regime

events.summary: A mother is challenging the Iranian government after her 16-year-old daughter was shot dead during mass protests in January. The shooting occurred while both were actively participating in demonstrations.
events.why: Documented fatalities of civilians during protests reflect ongoing human rights abuses and civil-state conflict in Iran.

articles.title: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent

events.summary: Cost-of-living protests across German cities including Berlin, Hamburg, and Frankfurt turned violent with reports of looted shops. The demonstrations coincided with widespread protests in France involving hundreds of thousands.
events.why: Coordinated unrest across major European economies highlights acute economic pressure capable of driving public disorder.
